item_name: Rothco Heavy Weight Steel Handle Folding Pick & Shovel
item_short_desc: Rothco’s Heavy Weight Steel Handle Folding Pick & Shovel is a versatile and durable survival tool designed for a wide range of outdoor activities. Constructed with heavy-duty steel, this folding pick and shovel combo offers years of reliable performance, whether you're camping, hiking, or dealing with tough terrain. description: Rothco’s Heavy Weight Steel Handle Folding Pick & Shovel is a versatile and durable survival tool designed for a wide range of outdoor activities. Constructed with heavy-duty steel, this folding pick and shovel combo offers years of reliable performance, whether you're camping, hiking, or dealing with tough terrain. The shovel features a sturdy, foldable design that allows it to be adjusted to a 90-degree angle, making it ideal for digging, separating hard materials, or even breaking up ice. The pick, measuring 6.5 inches in length, is perfect for more challenging tasks, while the serrated edge on the shovel makes cutting through roots and dense soil a breeze. The ergonomic, no-slip rubber grip ensures a secure and comfortable hold, even in wet or muddy conditions. Compact and easy to store, this folding pick and shovel is an essential addition to your outdoor gear, providing practical functionality in a portable design.
